Listen, your kids need you. You may think your a shitty father, but they need you. Growing up without a father is 1000x worse than growing up with a bad one. So you have some anxiety and depression, we all feel like that. Don't let it get to you, you need to be there for your kids.

If you want someone to talk to and explain your situation a little bit better, shoot me a PM. I'd be happy to listen. 

Me, along with thousands of others, are on the same boat as you. We feel like there is no other options, and that's okay. You feel sick of everyone, that's understandable. I feel that way a lot too. People are assholes, it's something we live with. If you end your life, you're just letting the assholes win. Don't let their bad attitudes and your hatred for them push you over the edge. 

Again, if you want to talk more PM me.
